goal: Create a complete single-page comic containing six irregular panels, narrating a light-hearted campus misunderstanding.

story.summary: Girl in the corridor has her skirt corner lifted by the wind, mistakenly thinks the boy behind her is taking a photo, but he is actually just replying to a message.
story.main_character: Girl with shoulder-length short hair, wearing a sailor suit, with a paint tube peeking out from the side pocket of her backpack, rich in expression.
story.supporting: A tall, thin boy in a hoodie, holding a phone in one hand, screen facing himself.

style.art_style: Japanese black and white shoujo manga + line dot pattern + strong black and white contrast

page_layout.panel_count: Vivid magenta background steals the scene.
page_layout.reading_direction: Japanese style: from right to left, from top to bottom

panels.size: Large grid from the top right to the mid-cross.
panels.scene: Wind blows the corridor curtains, girl holds down her skirt, glancing back cautiously
panels.text: Girl: Did you just raise your phone?

panels.scene: Guy stunned, phone screen shows a recognizable small thumbnail of the WeChat chat interface
panels.text: Guy: I'm replying to the group leader...

panels.scene: Close-up of girl's pupil, imagining a flash (using exaggerated vertical lines).
panels.text: Inner voice: No, he is quibbling!

panels.scene: Girl steps forward, finger nearly poking the phone case.
Guy helplessly scrolling, screen filled with course groups and file transfer assistant

panels.size: Large grid full width at the bottom.
panels.scene: Two people sitting side by side by the window, the girl whispers an apology, the boy scratches his head, cherry blossom petals float by outside
panels.text: Narration: When the wind is too strong, people tend to overthink.

dialogue_design.balloon_style: White background + black outline + sharp corners.
dialogue_design.narration_box: Rectangle with grey background + fine black border

must_keep: The main character is the same person, with a consistent uniform.
WeChat Used as a Small Prop, Not Overpowering the Main Narrative
avoid: No dot levels on the full page
